relation_specs.definition: Directed FinCausal relation from the causal fact/proposition to the effect fact/proposition; direction is semantic and independent of textual order.

layer01.effect_quantification: The effect is normally a quantified/measurable fact; the cause may be quantified or non-quantified.
layer01.text_order: Never assign causal direction from textual order.
layer01.span_policy: preserve exact source wording and long/noisy annotation-style spans
layer01.recall_policy: high recall; include all plausible CAUSE/EFFECT facts before relation adjudication
layer01.quantified_effect_prior: EFFECT is normally a quantified/measurable financial fact
layer01.connective_policy: pure causal connectives generally stay outside endpoints

layer02.direction: semantic CAUSE→EFFECT regardless of textual order
layer02.multiple_pairs: allow multiple supported causal pairs in one visible text
layer02.role_hints: clear CAUSE/EFFECT role hints may deterministically seed a positive relation; ambiguous pairs are classified

gold_policy: Gold entities and relations are loaded only after Layer 12.
